prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / companion playing-card illustration. Image 1 is the APPROVED FINISHED Design 2 King of Spades and is the authoritative reference. Create ONE matching King of HEARTS by changing only that King's identity, conventional pose and suit-specific colors. Match the approved card's exact 5:7 composition, reduced head-and-torso scale, broad sleeves spanning the interior near the center, rich yellow Ming silk round-collar dragon robe, red inner collar, jeweled plaque belt, black yishanguan cap with folded upward wings, dense Chinese lotus floral fields on BLACK ground, shaped antique-white reserve with fine gold tracery, diagonal woven waist join and small turquoise center jewel. Preserve the same fine warm outlines and softly shaded naturalistic Chinese faces/hands. Keep the luxurious yellow, teal, madder, ivory and gold balance. Do not enlarge the figure or reduce the floral density. The cap is Ming headwear, not a European crown or Qing conical hat. Preserve the narrow gold lotus-vine outer band, beaded gold rules, margin, and diagonal ivory corner panels at their exact source positions.
Exactly two opposing waist-up depictions of the same man. The lower portrait, hands, weapon, robe, background and index must be the precise 180-degree rotated counterpart of the upper, elegantly joined at the exact canvas center. Same face, age, costume and pose in both halves. Keep ALL caps, weapon tips, hands and accessories within the inner frame, with visible clearance. No objects may cross the border.
Single flat full-canvas card asset about 1060x1484, no mockup, scenery, watermark, extra lettering, new medallions, extra heads or limbs. Only the two K letters and two small solid suit symbols in the index panels. Graceful correct hands and clearly readable weapon grips.
HEARTS-SPECIFIC CHANGES: Image 2 supplies ONLY the Madder Lake border color, not an empty card layout. Change the outer border's black ground to Madder Lake #A73443, with exactly the same gold lotus vines. Keep the DENSE INTERIOR floral ground BLACK as in image 1. Change the two indices to red serif K and small plain red HEART; retain exact panel positions, sizes and rotated orientation.
Give this King a distinct dignified mature Chinese face, head turned gently toward viewer's LEFT with BOTH EYES visible. A neatly shaped chin-and-jaw beard is allowed, but the upper lip MUST be COMPLETELY CLEAN: NO MOUSTACHE, no whiskers over the lip. Keep same Ming cap and robe family, with subtle individual dragon embroidery.
ICONIC HEARTS POSE: replace the upright sword with the familiar sword-BEHIND-THE-HEAD playing-card arrangement. One raised hand on viewer's RIGHT beside the ear grips a compact gold mask-guard jian hilt; the blade travels diagonally upward toward viewer's LEFT, passing BEHIND the head and cap. Show part of the steel blade emerging beyond the opposite side of the cap, entirely within the inner frame. The sword is behind him, not contacting or injuring him. A natural bent elbow in its broad yellow sleeve. His other hand rests at the chest or belt. Exactly TWO HANDS per upright figure, not an extra inherited sword hand. The short visible blade segments read as one continuous straight sword occluded by the head. The lower half repeats this same man, clean upper lip, raised-hand pose and behind-head sword under 180-degree rotation. Do not accidentally retain the Spades upright blade.
correction_prompt:
Make ONE tiny localized correction to the supplied King of Hearts card: remove the moustache from BOTH portraits. The King of Hearts convention requires a clean-shaven UPPER LIP. On the top face remove ALL dark whiskers, moustache strokes and stubble BETWEEN the nostrils and upper lip and extending sideways from that area. Replace that moustache region with smooth naturally shaded skin matching the adjacent cheeks. Keep the natural lip contour, nose, expression, eyebrows, chin beard and jaw beard intact. The chin beard may remain, but it must be clearly separated from the nose by a smooth clean upper lip. Make the identical correction to the upside-down lower face. Do not merely thin the moustache: completely REMOVE it on both faces.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE in this exact card unchanged: the two Chinese kings and their identities, pose, behind-head sword, hands, hats, robes, figure scale, yellow silk, dense flowers, ivory reserve, red/gold border, red K/heart indices, diagonal center band, turquoise jewel and 5:7 canvas. No additions, no new marks, no other changes. Return one complete corrected card.
